title: Legora joins Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Legal launch as a legal AI partner
summary: Legora is working with Google Cloud to bring trusted legal AI capabilities into Gemini Enterprise for Legal, helping approved mutual customers access Legora’s legal intelligence from within broader enterprise AI workflows.
body_markdown:
Legora is participating as a launch partner in Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Legal preview. Through a beta MCP connection, approved mutual customers will be able to ask Legora legal questions from within Gemini Enterprise and receive text-based answers with links back to Legora for source review, citations, thread history, and continuity.


The launch reflects Legora’s broader vision for the future of legal AI: one where legal teams can access trusted legal intelligence wherever work happens, while keeping deeper legal workflows, context, permissions, and review anchored in Legora.


Legal teams are increasingly working across multiple AI environments. Enterprises may adopt Gemini Enterprise as a broader AI platform, while legal professionals continue to rely on Legora as their specialized workspace for complex legal work. This integration is designed to help bridge those environments.


With this initial beta capability, approved mutual customers can call Legora from Gemini Enterprise, submit a legal question, and receive an answer that connects back to the corresponding Legora thread or chat. From there, users can continue their work in Legora, where citations, source grounding, permissions, and legal context remain available for review.


“Legal teams are adopting AI across more parts of the enterprise, and they need trusted legal intelligence to be available in those environments,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “By working with Google Cloud on Gemini Enterprise for Legal, we’re making it easier for mutual customers to access Legora’s legal AI capabilities from within broader enterprise AI workflows, while keeping source review, citations, and deeper legal work grounded in Legora.”


"To deliver real value from agentic AI, legal professionals need domain-specific depth and verifiable reasoning they can trust," said Satish Thomas, Vice President, Google Cloud. "Connecting Legora directly into Gemini Enterprise for Legal allows legal teams to seamlessly execute complex inquiries, retrieve cited sources, and maintain rigorous governance without having to switch between disconnected tools."


For Legora, the launch marks another step toward a more interoperable legal AI ecosystem. As enterprise AI becomes a larger part of how organizations work, Legora is focused on making legal intelligence accessible across the systems customers already use, without compromising the depth, context, and control required for legal work.
